2608.24824.title: Constrained Entity Selection under Partial Knowledge for LLM-Based Knowledge Graph QA
2608.24824.paper_summary: Large language models are increasingly used for knowledge graph question answering (KGQA), but can fail to correctly ground answers in the underlying graph. Current approaches to LLM-based KGQA either rely on full semantic parsing into executable queries such as SPARQL, which is brittle in practice due to complex schemas or incompleteness of real-world KGs, or on LLM-reasoning and answer generation over KGs, which can be more robust but lacks formal guarantees. In this work, we study a complementary setting in which \emph{candidate} answers are generated by an LLM-based system and subsequently verified using lightweight symbolic constraints derived from the question. We introduce \emph{Constrained Entity Selection under Partial Knowledge (CES-PK)}, a problem formulation that focuses on eliminating invalid answers and providing symbolic support for valid ones without requiring construction of executable logical forms. To account for incomplete KGs, we employ a three-valued constraint semantics (\emph{satisfied, violated, unknown}) that avoids incorrect rejections under open-world assumptions. To demonstrate the effects of our method, we instantiate this framework over the Hetionet biomedical knowledge graph and evaluate the impact of type, relation, and exclusion constraints. Experiments show that precision improves by filtering invalid candidates, while recall is preserved due to retaining candidates whose constraints are not explicitly violated. Satisfied constraints provide additional positive symbolic evidence to rank remaining candidates.
2608.24824.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型越來越多地用於知識圖譜問答（KGQA），但可能無法正確地將答案與基礎圖譜對應。當前基於LLM的KGQA方法要麼依賴於將語義完全解析為可執行查詢，例如SPARQL，這在實踐中由於複雜的模式或現實世界KG的不完整性而顯得脆弱；要麼依賴於LLM推理和在KG上生成答案，這可能更穩健但缺乏正式保證。在本研究中，我們研究了一種互補的設置，其中\emph{候選}答案由基於LLM的系統生成，然後使用從問題中推導出的輕量級符號約束進行驗證。我們引入了\emph{部分知識下的約束實體選擇（CES-PK）}，這是一種問題表述，專注於消除無效答案並為有效答案提供符號支持，而不需要構建可執行的邏輯形式。為了考慮不完整的KG，我們採用了三值約束語義（\emph{滿足、違反、未知}），以避免在開放世界假設下的不正確拒絕。為了展示我們方法的效果，我們在Hetionet生物醫學知識圖譜上實現了這一框架，並評估了類型、關係和排除約束的影響。實驗表明，通過過濾無效候選者，精度得到了提高，而由於保留了那些約束未明確違反的候選者，召回率得以保持。滿足的約束提供了額外的正面符號證據，以對剩餘候選者進行排序。
2608.24824.author: Emanuel Kitzelmann et.al.
